title: Kirk McConnell and extended electrodynamics
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Kirk McConnell and extended electrodynamics, about unspecified at Washington, D.C., and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Senate Armed Services Committee, Washington DC

tellings.quote: So he's Senate Armed Services Committee and he was under Jack Reid um the senator from Rhode Island and he knows all about extended electronamics

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaks of a man named Kirk McConnell, who he says worked for the Senate Armed Services Committee, the group of US senators that oversees the military, under Senator Jack Reid of Rhode Island. Michels says McConnell knows all about extended electrodynamics, a proposed broader version of the physics of electricity and magnetism. The point is that someone close to military oversight in Congress would understand the kind of physics that might explain how such craft move.
